title: Import template download matches contract
objective: Verify GET /imports/template returns a CSV template whose headers match the documented importable fields, UTF-8 encoded, with no sample personal data.
steps: GET /api/v1/imports/template.
Verify content type, encoding, header row against OpenAPI/README documentation.
expected_result: 200 CSV (text/csv, UTF-8); headers exactly match documented field set incl. required markers; no real personal/financial sample values.

title: Import upload → validate/preview with row-level errors
objective: Verify POST /imports (multipart) parses the CSV, applies field mapping, and returns a validation preview with per-row/per-field errors and counts before any commit.
preconditions: Operator session; celery worker running (or eager mode documented).
test_data: CSV of 20 rows: 15 valid, 5 invalid (missing required name/category, bad date format, unknown category code, bad UUID reference, duplicate tag within file)
steps: POST /imports with the CSV and default mapping.
GET /imports/<uuid> until validation completes; inspect preview payload.
Verify no assets were created at this stage.
expected_result: Preview reports created/updated/skipped/failed projections with exact row numbers + field-level messages (IMPORT_ROW_INVALID details); zero writes before commit; job status transitions queued→processing→(validated/completed) observable.

title: Duplicate policies — reject / update / create behave per selection
objective: Verify the duplicate-handling policy (reject|update|create) is honored on commit for rows colliding on tag/serial per configuration.
preconditions: Existing asset with tag 'AST-DUP-1' and known serial.
test_data: 3 CSVs (or 3 jobs) each containing a row for tag AST-DUP-1, committed with policy reject / update / create respectively
steps: Commit job with policy=reject → row failed with duplicate reason; asset unchanged.
Commit job with policy=update → asset updated (version incremented, audited before/after).
Commit job with policy=create → behavior per spec (new unique tag or explicit rejection — document actual contract).
expected_result: Each policy produces the documented outcome with accurate counts; update path respects optimistic concurrency + audit; create-with-duplicate never violates tag uniqueness (BR-001).

title: Partial success authorization and result report
objective: Verify partial success commits valid rows only when the policy/user is authorized for it, and the result report (GET /imports/:uuid/result) details created/updated/skipped/failed with row/field messages.
preconditions: Validated import job with mixed valid/invalid rows (TC-FR-018-02).
steps: POST /imports/<uuid>/commit (with Idempotency-Key).
Poll job until completed; GET result report.
Verify created assets exist and invalid rows did not create partial records.
expected_result: Valid rows committed atomically per row (no half-written assets); failed rows listed with precise messages; counts in result report reconcile with database state; job + results audited; result downloadable/viewable only by authorized users.

title: CSV formula injection neutralized on import and export
objective: Verify cells beginning with = + - @ are treated as text on import (sanitized/flagged per spec) and that exports prefix dangerous leading characters.
test_data: CSV rows with name '=HYPERLINK("http://evil")', description '+CMD', serial '@evil', notes '-1+1'; then export those assets
steps: Import the weaponized CSV; verify stored values are literal text or sanitized per documented policy (no formula execution anywhere server-side).
Export the affected assets; open CSV and inspect the same fields' leading characters.
expected_result: Import never executes/interprets formulas; stored values documented (literal or prefixed); export prefixes dangerous leading chars (e.g., apostrophe) per design §13; UTF-8 encoding intact; no data corruption of legitimate negative numbers in numeric fields.

title: Import commit is idempotent and safely repeatable
objective: Verify re-committing the same job (retry/double-click) with the same Idempotency-Key does not duplicate created assets, and a second commit attempt returns the stored result.
preconditions: Validated import job ready to commit.
test_data: same Idempotency-Key sent twice; parallel commit attempts in pytest
steps: POST commit with key K; wait for completion; record created count.
POST commit again with key K (and once without key if contract allows); record behavior.
Verify asset counts and tag uniqueness.
expected_result: Second commit with same key returns the recorded response without re-executing; no duplicate assets; parallel attempts serialized safely; result report unchanged and consistent.

title: Import Unicode and encoding handling
objective: Verify UTF-8 CSVs with non-ASCII names/locations/notes import correctly (Unicode storage, A-01) without mojibake, and BOM-prefixed files are handled.
test_data: CSV with Japanese/Arabic/emoji names, accented locations, CRLF line endings, UTF-8 BOM variant
steps: Import and commit; fetch created assets; compare field values byte-accurately.
expected_result: All Unicode values round-trip exactly; BOM tolerated; invalid encoding rejected with clear error (not silent corruption).

title: Export respects filters, scope, and field permissions
objective: Verify POST /exports with filter parameters exports exactly the permitted, filtered record set; financial columns present only for finance-capable roles.
preconditions: Seeded assets across departments; operator (dept A) and auditor sessions.
test_data: filters: category=Laptops, status=In Use; export requested by operator (dept A) and auditor
steps: Request export as operator with filters; download result.
Request same export as auditor; download result.
Compare row sets to equivalent filtered /assets API responses for each user.
expected_result: Operator export contains only in-scope filtered rows, no finance columns; auditor export contains permitted rows incl. finance columns as decimal strings; row counts match list API truth; export job audited.

title: Async export lifecycle — status, download, expiry
objective: Verify large exports run async with observable status (queued→processing→completed), download via authorized endpoint, and expired/failed states behave per contract.
test_data: export request for all in-scope assets
steps: POST /exports; poll GET /exports/<uuid> until completed.
GET /exports/<uuid>/download; verify CSV content + headers.
Verify another user cannot download the file (403/404).
expected_result: Status transitions observable; completed export downloadable only by requester/authorized roles; file is UTF-8 CSV (BOM documented); expiry policy enforced/documented; failures surface user-safe error with correlation ID.

title: E2E Journey J-7 — bulk import assets from CSV via wizard
objective: UI journey through the import wizard: template download, upload, mapping, validate/preview with errors, policy selection, commit, result review.
preconditions: Full stack; Playwright; operator signed in.
steps: Open /imports; download template from wizard.
Upload CSV; proceed through mapping (defaults accepted).
Review validation preview: verify 2 invalid rows shown with row numbers + messages.
Select duplicate policy; commit; watch progress to completion.
Open /imports/<id> result; verify counts; spot-check one created asset in the register.
expected_result: Wizard steps match design §8.5 (clear labels, error summary, no loss of state on back-navigation); preview accurate; commit awaits backend confirmation; results reconcile with register; evidence screenshots captured.
